[⚠️ VIOLATED] [MEDIUM] CTA: Recommended 1 CTA per 300 words of content
  → Actual value: 0.0111

[⚠️ VIOLATED] [MEDIUM] CTA: Landing pages should have 1-3 focused CTAs maximum
  → Actual value: 10

[⚠️ VIOLATED] [MEDIUM] SEO: Pages should have at least 2 H2 tags to structure content
  → Actual value: 107

[⚠️ VIOLATED] [LOW] Content & UX: External links should open in new tabs and be used sparingly
  → Actual value: 109
  → Why it matters: Excessive external links leak PageRank and pull users away from your site before converting.

[✅ OK] [CRITICAL] CTA: Every page must have at least 1 CTA
  → Actual value: 10
  → Why it matters: A page with no CTA fails its primary conversion goal. Visitors have no clear next step.

  → Actual value: None
  → Why it matters: Titles under 50 chars miss keyword opportunities. Titles over 60 chars get truncated in Google SERPs, hurting click-through rates.

[ℹ️ INFO] [HIGH] SEO: Meta description should be between 150 and 160 characters
  → Actual value: None
  → Why it matters: Meta descriptions are the preview snippet in Google. Too short wastes the opportunity; too long gets cut off.

[✅ OK] [MEDIUM] Content & UX: Blog posts and landing pages perform best at 800-1500 words
  → Actual value: 901
  → Why it matters: HubSpot research shows 800-1500 word pages generate the most organic traffic and backlinks for marketing sites.

[✅ OK] [MEDIUM] SEO: Pages should have a minimum of 300 words for SEO value
  → Actual value: 901
  → Why it matters: Search engines consider thin content (under 300 words) low-value. Competitive pages typically have 800-1500 words.

[✅ OK] [LOW] Content & UX: Use H3 tags to break up long sections under H2s
  → Actual value: 3
  → Why it matters: H3 subheadings improve scanability. 79% of users scan rather than read web content (Nielsen Norman Group).

[✅ OK] [LOW] Content & UX: Marketing pages should include at least 1-2 images to break up text
  → Actual value: 70
  → Why it matters: Visual content increases time-on-page by 94% on average (Skyword research). Pure text pages have higher bounce rates.
